intro: The Fallow Sanctuary is a secluded village hidden deep within the bogs of the Swamp of Sorrows. It serves as home to an isolated tribe of mutated draenei known as the Lost Ones, whose severe grief and homesickness have driven them feral.

p: Tucked away among the sunken trees of the Swamp of Sorrows, the Fallow Sanctuary was established by stranded Lost Ones seeking a place of their own. Severed from their ancestral world and deformed by dark energies, these wretched outcasts found no peace in the marshland. Over time, relentless sorrow and isolation shattered their sanity, reducing the tribe to a hostile, feral state where they fiercely attack any outsiders who trespass into their village.
The settlement was once guided by figures like Ongeku and Noboru the Cudgel, though the village's leadership crumbled following their absence and demise.
